tasks.gr8-common-and-decimal-fractions-t3: Topic: Common and decimal fractions. Cover operations with fractions and decimals, conversions, and contextual calculations. Ask Grade 8 learners to switch forms accurately and avoid operation and place-value errors.
tasks.gr8-theorem-of-pythagoras-t3: Topic: Theorem of Pythagoras. Cover right-angled triangles, identifying the hypotenuse, and solving unknown sides. Ask Grade 8 learners to select when the theorem applies and calculate with square roots correctly.
tasks.gr8-area-perimeter-surface-area-and-volu: Topic: Area, perimeter, surface area and volume. Cover formulas for 2D and 3D measures, unit interpretation, and multi-step measurement tasks. Ask Grade 8 learners to choose the correct formula and unit in context.
tasks.gr8-data-handling-t3: Topic: Data handling. Cover data collection, representation, interpretation, and measures of central tendency. Ask Grade 8 learners to read graphs critically and compare what different displays reveal.
